function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Reconstruct the complete public evidence chain for the March–April 2023 3CX DesktopApp software supply-chain compromise, using only evidence and source IDs returned by the benchmark research tools. Investigate three connected areas: (1) how the compromise was initiated, identifying the earliest publicly supported access or delivery mechanism and all materially competing hypotheses; (2) how malicious code or activity propagated into, through, or from 3CX’s build environment and produced compromised Windows and macOS DesktopApp artifacts, carefully separating documented facts, company statements, vendor or government analytical assessments, allegations, and unresolved uncertainty; and (3) which threat-activity cluster the incident was publicly attributed to, naming the source making the attribution, its confidence level and evidentiary basis, alternative attributions, and contradictions or caveats. Return a source-indexed evidence dossier: for every relevant source provide its exact benchmark source ID, source type/authority, date if available, concise verbatim or faithful evidence summary, entities, relationships, and whether each point is fact, allegation, assessment, or uncertainty. Do not use or cite anything outside the benchmark-tool results; do not invent source IDs, entities, relationships, or conclusions. Explicitly flag unsupported or disputed points. The dossier must support a final readable Markdown report and a final fenced JSON object with arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions."}
function.name: ConductResearch
